verification_coverage: Every declared member and owning manifest hash/size/containment checked; every CAS object verified by readback hash/size/read-only mode.
method: Exclusive temporary write; fsync; 0444; renamex_np RENAME_EXCL; directory fsync; existing exact CAS objects reused without overwrite. Not WORM.
historical_status: Original failures, qualification and review outcomes retain their exact attribution. Preservation does not accept native/runtime/performance or reinterpret failed returns.
retrieval: MAP canonical SHA/size/path and alias indexes resolve through INPUTS to exact original paths and owning manifests.
preservation: All originals and prior objects/maps/history untouched. No Git, metadata, source, tests, builds, browser/native/runtime or deletion.
claim_limit: Derivative preservation only; no acceptance claim.
